title: eIDAS 2.0 EUDI Wallet Relying Party Readiness Scorer
description: Assesses organisational readiness to accept EU Digital Identity Wallets (EUDI) as strong customer authentication under eIDAS 2.0. Covers technical, operational, and governance readiness dimensions with prioritised gap list.

mcp_tool_definition.name: score_eidas2_eudi_relying_party_readiness
mcp_tool_definition.description: Score financial institution readiness to accept EUDI Wallet credentials under eIDAS 2.0 and identify technical/operational gaps. Local scoring against caller-supplied answers only — no submission to any wallet, registry, or supervisory system; no state change, no keys held, nothing certified or registered.
